The operation: define a constrained sampling problem; train a denoiser, flow, or guided sampler on demonstrations or feedback; then sample a coherent action chunk and execute only the first part before replanning.

Why the math helps: Guidance changes the score or velocity field so unsafe samples lose probability and feasible samples remain likely. This explains the mechanism without relying on benchmark names or unsupported numbers.
